narratives.Overview:
## Summary
Closed #4577 claimed lifecycle verbs deny common agent pipelines via an opaque "not inspectable (quoting, redirect, pipe, or chain)" rule. Recurrence on **0.119.2** / Grok Build during NoteTechnic phase-validate:

```
deft session:start -- --read-only
→ Hook denied: invocation is not inspectable (quoting, redirect, pipe, or chain).
  Re-run as a simple command with --session-id=host:claude:v1:…
```

The command had **no shell pipe/redirect** in the tool argv — only Directive own `--` passthrough for `--read-only`. Agents must discover the session-id re-run by trial and error. A later multi-step Shell script that merely *mentioned* session:start in a heredoc body was also denied as inspectable.

## Expected
Read-only session start accepts `deft session:start -- --read-only` (documented in AGENTS.md), or deny text names the exact illegal token instead of blaming quoting/pipes that are not present.

## Actual
Opaque inspectable deny; works only after adding `--session-id=host:claude:v1:…` (itself the #4708 Claude-namespace lie).

## Environment
Grok Build, macOS, `@deftai/directive@0.119.2`, consumer `deftai/notetechnic`.

## Related
Closed #4577 — treat as regression or incomplete fix.

Refutation of Stop 1 comment 5735437643 target: that `deft session:start -- --read-only` is classified uninspectable (quoting/redirect/pipe/chain) even though the only extra token is Directive own `--` passthrough.

The target does not survive at dispatch-sha f33b8b8e24c9746d02f66532bd1815271771e969.

## 1. Four-token argv is exact, not uninspectable

class: blocks-the-design

Evidence: ran `inspectExactLifecycleCommand` and `hintUninspectableLifecycleCommand` from dest `packages/core/src/hooks/classify/host-session-identity.ts` (triage line-cite used `packages/core/src/host-session-identity.ts`, which is not in this tree). For Bash, Shell, and `run_terminal_command`, command `deft session:start -- --read-only`:

- `INSPECTABLE_TOKEN_PATTERN` matches both `--` and `--read-only`
- exact = `{ verb: session:start, requiresOwner: false, rewriteSafe: false, sessionIdStatus: absent }`
- hinted = null

`directive session:start -- --read-only` is the same pair. `task session:start -- --read-only` is exact with `rewriteSafe: true` because Task `--` is the CLI_ARGS boundary, not an unknown flag. `deft session:start --read-only` is exact with `requiresOwner: false` and `rewriteSafe: true`.

The occupancy-identity-unavailable copy that names quoting, redirect, pipe, or chain is reached only when exact is null and the hint returns a verb (`attachLifecycleIdentityRewrite` after the shell allow). That pair is false for the documented four-token argv. v0.119.2 `analyzeLifecycleArguments` already continues on unknown flags; it does not return null for `--`.

Failure mode: a next-build that "makes `--` inspectable" is already dest behavior. Binding the recorded target recuts the wrong site and cannot produce the 0.119.2 deny string from this argv.

Disposition: do not bind the recorded refutation-target as written.

## 2. rewriteSafe false is not the uninspectable class

class: sharpens-framing

Evidence: on the deft/directive branch, a lone `--` is an unknown forwarded arg, so `rewriteSafe` is false, while `--read-only` still sets `readOnly` and `requiresOwner` false. `rewriteExactLifecycleCommand` returns null when not rewrite-safe. `attachLifecycleIdentityRewrite` returns the prior allow when `requiresOwner` is false and does not consult `rewriteSafe` for the quoting/pipe/chain copy.

Failure mode: treating "outside auto-rewrite" as "uninspectable" yields a `--` allowlist that does not touch the deny path.

Disposition: keep rewrite vs hint as separate classes if P1 is restated.

## 3. Exact-miss plus hint is what emits that copy

class: sharpens-framing

Evidence: `exactLifecycleInvocation` returns null when `command !== command.trim()`, when `split(" ")` yields an empty token, or when a token fails the inspectable pattern. Those misses still hint `session:start`. Measured hinted=`session:start` for trailing space, leading space, trailing newline, CRLF, double space, tabs, and `deft session:start -- --read-only | Out-Null`. Heredoc `cat <<EOF\ndeft session:start --read-only\nEOF` is the same pair. Quoted `echo 'deft session:start -- --read-only'` and `bash -lc '...'` are exact null and hinted null (quoted strings are not invocations).

Closed #4577 body already reproduced the piped form (`-- --read-only` piped to head) plus heredoc compound issue-create, and said a simple re-run works. #4780's second report (a multi-step Shell that only mentioned `session:start` in a heredoc body) is that hint path, not `--`.

Failure mode: the deny text always blames quoting/redirect/pipe/chain, including when the miss is whitespace or a heredoc mention. Agents then add `--session-id=host:claude:v1:…` by trial (#4708 namespace on the claude wire host).

Disposition: a surviving P1 recut is "exact-miss falls through to a false-cause hint deny", not "`--` is uninspectable". Do not drop the chain deny.

## Injection / swarm

The surface is occupancy identity and lifecycle `--session-id` rewrite (host owner, concurrent claim). The hint fail-closed on chain/pipe/redirect is load-bearing. Trimming then rewriting a command whose newline hid a second segment would bind the wrong owner. Keep fail-closed on true compound forms. Skipping `--` on the deft branch is not an occupancy-identity control.

## Road not taken

Skip lone `--` on the deft branch to match #3914 CLI skip and Task CLI_ARGS, so `rewriteSafe` stays true for the agents-entry spelling. That does not flip the uninspectable copy, which does not fire on the trimmed four-token argv.

Steelmans of the recorded target: the 0.119.2 Grok deny string is real, so classification must have failed on `--`. Flip condition: `inspectExactLifecycleCommand` returning null for the trimmed four-token command at this SHA. Measured: it does not.

## Footnotes

class: footnote. Hook tests lock `deft session:start --read-only`, not the agents-entry `deft session:start -- --read-only`. `agents_md_session_start.test.ts` locks `-- --` in agents-entry and forbids that spelling in commands.md (commands.md uses `deft session:start --read-only` and `task session:start -- --read-only`).

class: footnote. Native host grok is outside `UPDATED_INPUT_WIRE_HOSTS`, so `attachLifecycleIdentityRewrite` is a no-op there. The filed `--session-id=host:claude:v1:` string is the claude wire host (Grok vendor-compat), not native grok.

class: footnote. `inspectHintedLifecycleSessionId` matching-owner carve-out already allows a hinted command that names the host owner. That is the recovery the deny prints, not evidence that `--` is the illegal token.

Inventory: `inspectExactLifecycleCommand`, `hintUninspectableLifecycleCommand`, `inspectHintedLifecycleSessionId`, `analyzeLifecycleArguments` `--read-only` booleanFlags, Task `--` CLI_ARGS boundary, `attachLifecycleIdentityRewrite` hinted deny, #4431, #3914, closed #4577 body. Did not run vitest (dest `node_modules` absent); did run the dest inspect functions via tsx.
